Subject: Proposal for Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Dear Morgan,

I propose a focused six-week pilot to assess invoice handling, giving us concrete evidence on whether handling time can be improved before any wider decision is considered.

Scope and terms:
- Six-week assessment of invoice handling
- Target to test: your hope for 20% shorter handling time (no baseline or measured savings yet exists)
- $30,000 fixed fee for the pilot
- Production rollout excluded

This contained scope lets us evaluate the opportunity while keeping the commitment limited to the pilot.

Please approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance. Security approval will be required before we access any client data, and no start date is being assumed as approved.

If you approve, the next decision can move forward on that basis.

Best regards,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
